title: Convex migration for realtime voting and user flows
description: Refactor the app to use Convex for voting, realtime leaderboard updates, and user signup/profile-related flows while keeping Postgres available for non-voting future use.

title: Configure Prettier to support Svelte files
description: Running npx prettier --check web/src/components/VoteModule.svelte fails with: No parser could be inferred. Add required Prettier Svelte support (plugin/config) so .svelte files can be formatted and checked in local/CI workflows.

title: Create Postgres-to-Convex migration/backfill for existing voting and user data
description: Add one-off backfill tooling and verification checks to move existing vote/user data to Convex without losing referential consistency.

title: Fix Convex vote mutation OCC failures under concurrent load
description: Realtime validation shows POST /api/v1/votes fails heavily under 100 concurrent users due to Convex OptimisticConcurrencyControlFailure while patching imageRatings. Implement retry/serialization strategy so concurrent votes on hot images do not fail and p95 latency can meet target.
close_reason: Implemented queued vote writes with worker serialization; validation now passes 100-concurrent load and correctness checks.

title: Add corny winner animation for A/B vote selections
description: Implement a fun, intentionally corny celebration animation when a user picks the winning image in the A/B voting module (e.g., brief burst/confetti/stamp effect), while keeping vote flow snappy and avoiding layout shift on mobile and desktop.

title: Migrate user signup and profile records to Convex
description: Store and read user signup/profile records from Convex; keep auth integration intact and map auth identities to Convex user documents.

title: Set up Convex project integration and env wiring
description: Add Convex client/server setup, configure environment.local keys, and verify app can query Convex in local and production modes.

title: Improve image detail navigation with modal popup and explicit close/back
description: Make image opening/navigation more intuitive: when clicking an image, present it in a popup/modal-style detail view using modern CSS patterns (responsive, accessible overlay, focus handling), and include a clear X close button that returns users to the previous page/state. Preserve deep-link support for direct image URLs.

title: Migrate voting read/write path from Postgres to Convex
description: Replace vote mutations and vote queries with Convex functions, including concurrency-safe vote updates for high write volume.

title: Refine upload form UX: progressive fields + playful file picker CTA
description: On the upload page, hide title and description inputs until a file is selected. Replace the current small 'Browse' file input affordance with a larger, more playful and obvious call-to-action while preserving accessibility and mobile usability.

title: Fix lint scope/config for TS and generated build artifacts
description: npm run lint currently reports hundreds of pre-existing errors because ESLint is scanning generated dist/.astro files and lacks TS-aware parser/env configuration for API/Convex sources. Add proper ignore patterns and language settings so lint gates reflect source code quality.

title: Improve A/B matchup load speed and eliminate layout shift
description: Optimize the A/B voting module so next matchup appears near-instantly (target sub-500ms perceived load, ideally preloaded) and ensure zero layout shift while loading/replacing images. Add stable placeholders/skeleton dimensions and update transitions to avoid content jumping on both mobile and desktop.

title: Implement realtime leaderboard and gallery updates via Convex subscriptions
description: Refactor toplist/gallery data fetching to use Convex reactive queries so vote totals and rankings update live without polling.

title: Add load and correctness validation for realtime voting
description: Define and run tests for realtime behavior under ~100 concurrent users, including leaderboard consistency and update latency targets.
close_reason: Added automated realtime voting validation harness and executed 100-concurrent run; captured latency and consistency metrics plus failure signatures.
